notes: The south wing on the architects' "First Floor Plan" sheet sits a level above the wing's ground floor (the site slopes): UCLA GIS restroom 2113, floor 2, lands in its restroom block, so it is recorded as floor 2. Uncertain: the plan has no room numbers.
No room numbers on the plan: rooms are unlabeled spaces, corridors, stairs and restrooms.
how: Architects' plan with a 25/50/100 ft scale bar (100 ft = 270 px, 11.25 cm/px) and a north arrow. With that scale, the rotation (-1.9 deg) and position come from fitting the building footprint on the sheet to the building outline (median 2.7 m, 90% within 8.4 m; the outline is OSM's roof line). Check: UCLA GIS restroom 2113 (floor 2) lands in the restroom block of the south wing. Four synthetic control points carry that transform.
